item.title: The Moments, Scenes, And Plots That Ruined Great Franchises
item.description: Franchises tend to grow because they have a strong fanbase behind them, but that doesn't make them infallible. With Hollywood's obsession with franchise films and IP, it's no wonder that almost every new release is a part of a larger universe of stories. item.title: 20 Movies That Redeemed Dying Franchises
item.description: Every great franchise has a rise to the peak, and unfortunately, many, if not all, have suffered from some major lows. item.title: The Best Chapters of Poppy Playtime, Ranked

Each chapter brings its own brand of scares, clever puzzles, and unforgettable villains, making the franchise a must-play for anyone who loves suspense, a good mystery, and a plethora of jump scares from their favorite horror games.
